text: I want to show you guys how I make this drink that has helped me depot my face, depot my body. Anytime I have a lot of inflammation or water attention, this helps me so much. It's natural, it's a biscuit tea, but I want to show you guys how I make an extract. That lasts me such a long time in the fridge and it's really easy to do. The only thing you're going to need is herbiscuits flowers. I weigh them out. I get around 40 grams of the flour. I give them a good rinse and then I fill up around one liter of water, set it up to boil, which takes a long time. And then once I put the flowers inside, I let it boil for five to seven minutes and then I set up this contraction to catch the extract and I needed Lucas to help me because it's not easy. So once we've finally got the extract, all you really have to do is take a glass of water, add some of the extract into your liking. I added in some monk fruit, stirred it up, and now you have an incredible hibiscus drink.
